body: https://github.com/CliMA/slurm-buildkite/pull/130 broke the ClimaAtmos depot build, which assumed that the environment variable `JULIA_DEPOT_PATH` would only have one entry. This PR fixes the depot (working [build](https://buildkite.com/clima/atmos-depot/builds/195#01a188ed-58d2-43c6-8db8-71981f45fcf2)).
